_about: Rival bot clan (src/sim/bot.js, docs/rival_bot_plan.md). difficulty picks a level (Tim 2026-10-19: easy for now). Any knob left out of a level uses BOT_DEFAULTS in bot.js. thinkSeconds: how often it picks a goal; reactSeconds: how often it handles fights; reserve: ryo kept back when hiring; escort: crew kept following the boss (the rest are stationed, one per business: stationPerBusiness); patrolChance: chance it walks to one of its places when idle; attackChance / attackMinCrew / attackMaxHeat: night attacks on unclaimed businesses; huntBandits / huntRange: hunt night bandits for ryo; bribeAtHeat: bribe the police from this heat; raidChance / raidMinCrew / raidReserve: War Lantern raids (scouts the target first); raidWhenWeak: only raid when the owner's boss is far away or the police are on them; memorySeconds: how long scouted info counts; ambush / ambushRange: jump lone rival crew near its own places; heroPriority: crew go for the rival boss first; focusFire: all crew hit the weakest enemy; executeDowned: finish off downed rival crew when safe; retreatHp: send crew below this share of HP to the clinic (0 = never); abilities: which of its boss's Q E R F it uses.
